vision: Make AGENTS.md the portable project-memory onboarding path (template + missing-only adopt + bootstrap skill + optional absence nudge) without inventing content or duplicating session harness.

tasks.name: Ship minimal AGENTS.md template in the library
tasks.scope: includes: skeleton with commands/landmines/pointers sections as consumer starter; excludes: full codebase overview dump, rewriting this repo's root AGENTS.md as the product

tasks.name: Adopt/sync installs AGENTS.md only when missing
tasks.scope: includes: setup/sync path places template as AGENTS.md for consumers lacking one; excludes: overwriting an existing AGENTS.md, auto-create via hooks

tasks.name: Opt-in agents-bootstrap skill adapts the template
tasks.scope: includes: light skill that fills/adapts template with real project commands; excludes: /init-style auto-dump of tree/stack, always-on invocation

tasks.name: Optional sessionStart nudge when AGENTS.md is absent
tasks.scope: includes: side-effect-thin one-line pointer to template/skill if missing; excludes: auto-create, long sermon, alwaysApply onboarding rule

tasks.name: Align dogfood root AGENTS.md and catalog pointers
tasks.scope: includes: light alignment of this repo's AGENTS.md + skill/catalog mentions with the new mental model; excludes: turning root AGENTS.md into the shipped template or a full rewrite
